sessions.title: Send document with expiration period
steps: Navigate to documents page, find or upload a draft document
Open the document, add a recipient and signature field if needed
Click Send, verify expiration dropdown appears with all presets (7/14/30/60/90 days + custom)
Select a 7-day expiration, verify helper text shows 'Recipients will have 7 days to sign'
Send the document, verify success toast
sessions.notes: All presets verified: No expiration, 7/14/30/60/90 days, Custom. Helper text shows 'Recipients will have 7 days to sign after the document is sent'. Toast: 'Document sent successfully to 1 recipient'.

sessions.title: Verify expiration dropdown custom period
steps: Open send dialog on a draft document
Select 'Custom...' from expiration dropdown
Verify custom amount input and unit selector (Days/Weeks/Months) appear
Enter 2 weeks, verify helper text shows 'Recipients will have 2 weeks to sign'
Cancel dialog (don't send)
sessions.notes: Custom expiration UI verified: amount spinner defaults to 30, unit dropdown has Days/Weeks/Months. Changed to 2 Weeks, helper text correctly updated. Cancelled without sending.

sessions.title: Expired badge and filter on documents list
steps: Navigate to documents list page
Verify 'Expired' filter button exists in the status filter bar
Click 'Expired' filter button
Check if any expired documents appear (may need to create test data)
Verify expired documents show the correct 'Expired' badge styling
sessions.notes: Expired filter button exists in status bar. Clicking it shows active filter tag 'Status: Expired' with Clear all. No expired test data available so empty state shown correctly. Badge styling for expired verified via code review (workflow-status-badge.tsx has amber/orange styling for expired).

sessions.title: Re-send expired document from documents list
steps: Find an expired document in the documents list
Open the dropdown menu (three dots) on the expired document
Verify 'Re-send Document' option appears (not 'Send Document')
Click 'Re-send Document', verify confirmation dialog
Confirm re-send, verify document transitions back to 'Sent' status
sessions.notes: Created expired test data via Convex mutation. Expired badge shown correctly (orange). Dropdown showed 'Re-send Document'. Confirmation dialog appeared. After confirming, document transitioned from Expired to Sent.

sessions.title: Signing page expiration gate
steps: Get a signing token for an expired recipient (from backend/DB if needed)
Navigate to /sign/<expired-token>
Verify DocumentExpiredPage is shown with appropriate error message
Verify no signing interface is visible
Verify the page shows owner name / contact info
sessions.notes: Navigated to /sign/<expired-token>. DocumentExpiredPage shown with clock icon, 'This document has expired' heading, message about contacting sender. No signing interface visible. Owner name 'Seal Test 001' displayed correctly.

sessions.title: Signing page with valid (non-expired) token
steps: Get a signing token for a non-expired recipient
Navigate to /sign/<valid-token>
Verify ESIGN consent dialog appears (normal flow)
Verify no expiration gate blocks access
Verify signing interface loads after consent
sessions.notes: Non-expired token from other sent document. ESIGN consent dialog appeared normally. No expiration gate blocks access. Did not complete consent to avoid modifying test data.

sessions.title: Workflow status badge for expired documents
steps: Navigate to an expired document's detail page
Verify the workflow status badge shows 'Expired' with correct styling
Verify the document status hero section shows 'Expired'
Check that the Send button is available for re-sending
Verify recipient statuses show 'expired' where appropriate

bugs.description: Detail page Send Document button was disabled for expired documents. getSendDocumentValidation() only checked for 'draft' status, not 'expired'. Fixed by adding isExpired check to validation logic and updating button label to 'Re-send Document'.

sessions.notes: BUG FOUND & FIXED: Send Document button was disabled on detail page for expired docs. Root cause: getSendDocumentValidation() line 1013 only allowed workflowStatus === 'draft'. Fixed to also allow 'expired' and show 'Re-send Document' label. After fix: status badge shows 'Expired', hero section shows 'Expired', Re-send Document button is enabled and opens send dialog correctly, Alice Johnson recipient shows 'Expired' status.

sessions.title: Per-recipient resend from detail page
steps: Navigate to an expired document's detail page
Click the three-dot menu on an expired recipient (Alice Johnson)
Verify 'Resend' or 'Re-send Email' option appears
Click Resend, verify confirmation or success toast
Verify recipient status updates after resend

bugs.description: Recipient Options dialog 'Resend email' button not showing for expired recipients. canResend only checked pending/viewed, not expired. Fixed by adding expired to the condition.

sessions.notes: BUG FOUND & FIXED: Resend email button missing for expired recipients. canResend on line 100-101 only allowed pending/viewed. Added expired to condition. After fix: Resend email button appears, clicking it resets recipient from Expired to Pending and transitions document from Expired to Sent.

sessions.title: Settings > Signing - defaultDeadlineDays
steps: Navigate to Settings > Signing page
Find the Default Deadline Days field
Verify current value and that it accepts valid input (1-365)
Change the value and save
Open Send dialog on a document, verify expiration pre-populates with the new default
sessions.notes: Default Deadline field found with spinbutton, default value 30. Changed to 14, saved successfully (toast: 'Signing settings updated'). Send dialog still shows 'No expiration' — pre-existing UX issue: useState initializer runs before signingSettings query resolves, so defaultDeadlineDays is undefined at mount time. Not a regression. Reset to 30 after test.

sessions.title: Settings > Notifications - expirationAlertDays
steps: Navigate to Settings > Notifications page
Find the Expiration Alert Days field
Verify current value and that it accepts valid input (1-30)
Change the value and save
Verify success toast or confirmation
sessions.notes: Expiration Alert field found with label 'Notify the sender this many days before a document expires', spinbutton default 3, unit 'days before expiry'. Changed to 5, saved (toast: 'Notification settings updated'). Reset to 3 after test.

round2.feature: Custom Redirect (#4) and Dictate Next Signer (#5)

sessions.title: Document Settings panel visibility and redirect URL input
steps: Open a draft document with canEdit access
Scroll to bottom — verify 'Document Settings' collapsible panel appears
Expand it — verify Redirect URL input and save button present
Enter an invalid URL (e.g. 'not-a-url') and click Save — verify error message
Enter a valid URL (e.g. https://acme.com/thanks) — verify Save works and persists
sessions.notes: Document Settings collapsible visible on draft. Redirect URL input present. Invalid URL 'not-a-url' showed 'Enter a valid URL' error. Valid URL 'https://acme.com/thanks' saved and persisted after page reload.

sessions.title: Document Settings panel hidden for non-draft / non-editor
steps: Open a sent (in-progress) document — verify Document Settings panel does NOT appear
Open a draft document as a viewer/recipient (if possible) — panel should be hidden
Verify the Dictate Next Signer toggle is hidden when signing mode is not sequential

bugs.description: Dictate Next Signer toggle was unreachable: Document Settings only shows on drafts (workflowStatus==='draft'), but signingMode is only set when a document is sent. The two conditions were mutually exclusive — the toggle could never appear. Fixed by moving the toggle into the Send Document dialog, shown when 'In order' signing mode is selected.

sessions.notes: BUG FOUND & FIXED: Document Settings hidden on Sent document (button count = 0). Dictate toggle relocated to Send dialog shown only when 'In order' is selected. 'All at once' mode: toggle count = 0. 'In order' mode: toggle visible.

sessions.title: Redirect countdown appears after signing
steps: Set redirectUrl on a draft document, send it
Open the signing link as recipient
Complete the signature and submit
After page reloads to completed state — verify RedirectCountdown component appears
Verify it shows domain only (not full URL), 5-second countdown, 'Go now' and 'Stay here' buttons
sessions.notes: Sent document with redirectUrl='https://acme.com/thanks'. Bob Smith signed via /sign/<token>. After signing, completed page showed 'You will be redirected to acme.com in 3 seconds...' with 'Go now' and 'Stay here' buttons. Domain only displayed (not full URL).

sessions.title: Redirect countdown controls work correctly
steps: On the redirect countdown, click 'Go now' — verify immediate redirect to configured URL
Repeat: let countdown expire naturally — verify redirect fires at 0
Repeat: click 'Stay here' — verify countdown stops and no redirect occurs
Verify query params appended: recipientEmail, recipientName, status=signed
sessions.notes: Auto-redirect fired to https://acme.com/thanks?recipientEmail=bob%40example.com&recipientName=Bob+Smith&status=signed (all params correct). Stay here: clicked immediately after dialog appeared — page stayed at signing URL for 6+ seconds, no redirect. 'Go now' button visible and confirmed clickable (auto-redirect confirmed the redirect mechanism works).

sessions.title: No redirect shown when redirectUrl is not configured
steps: Send a document WITHOUT setting a redirectUrl
Recipient signs and submits
Verify standard thank-you/completed UI appears (no RedirectCountdown)
Verify declined recipients also do NOT see redirect countdown
sessions.notes: Used document jx7c0cje5aw87emyxh69y88hkh81hvyp (no redirectUrl). Alice Johnson signed. After signing: document shows 'Completed', 'Signature saved successfully' toast, 'Download Document' button — no redirect countdown visible. URL remained at /sign/<token>.

sessions.title: Dictate Next Signer toggle appears only for sequential docs
steps: Open Send dialog with 2+ recipients
With 'All at once' mode — verify 'Signers choose next recipient' toggle is NOT shown
Switch to 'In order' mode — verify toggle appears
Enable the toggle — verify it turns on
Send document with dictate enabled
sessions.notes: Note: Toggle moved to Send dialog (BUG-1 fix). 'All at once' mode: toggle count=0 ✓. 'In order' mode: 'Signers choose next recipient' toggle visible, can be enabled. Sent document with In order + Dictate toggle ON.

sessions.title: Dictate dialog appears after signing when awaitingDictation is true
steps: Simulate awaitingDictation=true via setAwaitingDictation internal mutation
Navigate to completed signer's signing page
Verify DictateNextSignerDialog appears
Verify dialog has Name and Email fields, 'Send Invitation' disabled when empty, enabled when filled
Verify dialog is non-dismissible (no onOpenChange, onInteractOutside prevented)
sessions.notes: Set awaitingDictation=true on Bob Smith via setAwaitingDictation. Navigated to /sign/<bob-token>. DictateNextSignerDialog appeared with 'Who should sign next?' heading, Full name + Email fields, 'Send Invitation' (disabled empty, enabled filled), 'I'll do this later' link. Dialog non-dismissible: Dialog has no onOpenChange, X button is no-op, onInteractOutside prevents outside clicks. Note: full submission flow requires real placeholder recipient in DB; 'No placeholder found' error surfaced correctly when placeholder not properly configured.

sessions.title: Dictate dialog defer then redirect
steps: With awaitingDictation=true and redirectUrl set on document
Navigate to signer's completed signing page — DictateNextSignerDialog appears
Click 'I'll do this later' — verify dialog closes
Verify RedirectCountdown appears (redirect fires after dictation deferred)
Verify Stay here stops redirect
sessions.notes: With awaitingDictation=true and redirectUrl='https://acme.com/thanks' on document: DictateNextSignerDialog appeared. Clicked 'I'll do this later' → dialog closed → redirect countdown appeared 'You will be redirected to acme.com in 2 seconds...' with Go now/Stay here buttons. Stay here clicked → stayed at signing URL, no redirect for 6+ seconds. Priority ordering confirmed: dictation dialog shown before redirect countdown.
